parameters.content:
## Purpose
Queue up to five consent-checked video background-removal jobs, then turn provider responses into an auditable delivery checklist. The workflow supports transparent, blurred and solid-color backgrounds; validates duration and settings before any paid request; avoids automatic POST retries; and flags transparency/audio metadata that still needs human review.

## Setup
Run the default offline demo first. It creates a transparent-WebM fixture record without credentials or network calls. For live use, replace providerBaseUrl with an authorized processing API, configure n8n Header Auth on both HTTP nodes, verify its schema and set allowPaidProcessing to true. The generic contract uses POST /jobs returning jobId and GET /jobs/{jobId} returning status, resultUrl and optional output metadata. Store all secrets in n8n credentials.

## Validation and execution
Every job needs a unique ID, an HTTPS source, permission evidence and a duration of no more than ten minutes. Choose fast, balanced or quality edge mode. Solid colors require #RRGGBB. Each approved request receives a stable idempotency key. Submission happens once; bounded polling prevents an endless loop. Ambiguous transport outcomes remain visible so the operator can inspect provider usage before deciding whether to retry.

## QA and recovery
For transparent output, WebM or MOV plus alpha=true is reported as metadata-ready, not visually approved. Other outcomes are flagged for alpha, edge, spill and audio review. The workflow never publishes or deletes media. Download outputs before execution retention expires and keep the rights reference with the final asset.

## Attribution
Created by Shisan Hua, who works on [Video Background Remover](https://www.videobgremover.org/). The template uses a generic authorized provider contract and does not claim a public Video Background Remover API.
